issue.title: Add a Dropbox connector
issue.body:
Dropbox is a common request. It is RPC-style (every call is a POST with a JSON body), so reads that use POST should be marked `effect: "read"`.

Start with `pnpm new:connector dropbox` and read [docs/writing-connectors.md](docs/writing-connectors.md). Cover listing a folder (with its cursor), file metadata, search, sharing links, and delete (destructive). File upload and download can be left out for the first version; say so in the file.

Mark it `docs-based` unless you ran it against a real account, and add tests for the failure paths.

issue.title: [PAY-003] Missing Stripe/Razorpay Webhook Endpoint & Signature Verification

labels.name: billing
labels.description: Payment gateway, subscriptions, and quota enforcement

issue.body:
### Summary
There is no webhook handler endpoint for Stripe or Razorpay events (`invoice.payment_succeeded`, `customer.subscription.deleted`).

### Requirements
1. Implement `POST /api/v1/billing/webhooks/stripe`.
2. Validate raw request body against `stripe-signature` header using `stripe.Webhook.construct_event(payload, sig, endpoint_secret)`.
3. Handle subscription lifecycle events.

issue.title: [PAY-001] Zero Payment Verification in Plan Upgrades (Free Enterprise Tier Exploit)

labels.name: billing
labels.description: Payment gateway, subscriptions, and quota enforcement

issue.body:
### Summary
`POST /api/v1/billing/change-plan` directly updates `tenants.plan_id` to Enterprise (₹9,999) without contacting any payment gateway or charging a credit card.

### File Location
- `platform/api/routes/billing.py:104-155`

### Impact
Any tenant can self-upgrade to the highest tier for free.

### Architectural Solution
Implement Stripe Checkout Sessions / SetupIntents:
1. Client calls `POST /billing/checkout-session` -> returns Stripe Checkout URL.
2. Database plan is only updated upon receipt of verified `checkout.session.completed` webhook.

issue.title: [SEC-001] Global PostgreSQL RLS Bypass via Supabase service_role Key

labels.name: database
labels.description: PostgreSQL schema, migrations, and transactional integrity

issue.body:
### Summary
Over 95% of API routes in `platform/api` query the database using `SupabaseManager` with `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY`. In Supabase/PostgreSQL, the `service_role` key has the `BYPASSRLS` attribute enabled, completely bypassing all Row-Level Security policies.

### File Location
- `platform/api/utils/supabase_client.py:10-25`
- `migrations/035_rls_tenant_isolation.sql:104`

### Impact & Attack Vector
If an application query omits `.eq("tenant_id", tenant_id)`, rows are exposed across tenants. Multi-tenancy currently relies on application-level filtering rather than database-level enforcement.

### Recommended Remediation
Migrate tenant-scoped queries to the `asyncpg` connection pool with `get_tenant_connection(tenant_id)` which runs `SET LOCAL app.current_tenant_id = $1` (or authenticated PostgREST client passing the user JWT). Reserve `service_role` exclusively for cross-tenant maintenance scripts.

issue.title: [Feat]: Data grid: copy all column names (one per line or as a JSON array)

type.name: Feature
type.description: A request, idea, or new functionality

issue.body:
### 🚀 Feature Proposal

Add **Copy column names → One per line / As JSON array** to the column header context menu. It copies every column of the current result, in grid order, as `id\nname\nemail` or `["id","name","email"]`.

### Motivation

Building a SELECT list, a field mapping or documentation from a result means retyping the names: the header menu only copies the name of the clicked column.

### Where to start

- Column header menu in `src/components/ui/DataGrid.tsx` (the `headerContextMenu` items, next to **Copy column name**). `ContextMenu` supports a `submenu`.
- Pure helpers in `src/utils/clipboard.ts`, e.g. `columnNamesAsLines(columns)` and `columnNamesAsJson(columns)` (`JSON.stringify(columns)`).
- Use the grid's `columns` prop: it is already in the result's original order. Columns with an empty name (e.g. `SELECT 1 AS ""`) are copied as empty strings.
- Optional: expose the same action as a result command in the command palette (`src/utils/builtInCommands.ts`).

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Both entries copy all columns in grid order and show a success toast.
- [ ] The JSON output is valid and escapes quotes and backslashes in names.
- [ ] Unit tests for both helpers in `tests/utils/clipboard.test.ts`.

### Contributor notes

- Comment here before starting so the issue can be assigned to you.
- Follow the [repo rules](https://github.com/TabularisDB/tabularis/tree/main/.rules) (TypeScript, React, design tokens, accessibility, testing).
- Any new UI string needs a key in every locale under `src/i18n/locales/`.
- Run `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm test` before opening the PR.
- Questions? Ask here or on [Discord](https://discord.com/invite/K2hmhfHRSt).
